records.jp: こういう灯籠って、ホラーっぽさがあって<CR>ちょっとワクワクするよね
records.en_original: These stone lanterns are kinda spooky, aren't they?
records.en: These stone lanterns are kinda spooky, aren't they?

records.jp: そういうもの？<CR>……わたしはピンとこないなあ
records.en_original: You think? I don't really feel that looking at them.
records.en: You think? I don't really feel that looking at them.

records.jp: 真っ暗な中にポツンと立ってて、<CR>近づいたら勝手に火がついたり……
records.en_original: Imagine walking in the pitch dark, when you see a lone lantern in your path. You take a step forward, only for a flame to suddenly appear...
records.en: Imagine walking in the pitch dark, when you see a lone lantern in your path. You take a step forward, only for a flame to suddenly appear...

records.jp: おおー
records.en_original: Ooh.
records.en: Ooh.

records.jp: ね、怖いでしょ？
records.en_original: See? Scary, right?
records.en: See? Scary, right?

records.jp: すっごく親切
records.en_original: More helpful than scary.
records.en: More helpful than scary.

records.jp: ……そうだね。便利だね。スマートホームだね
records.en_original: ...You're totally right. Just like one of those smart homes...
records.en: ...You're totally right. Just like one of those smart homes...

records.jp: 夜道で灯籠の明かりの側に怪しい影が……
records.en_original: Imagine walking down a road at night by lantern light, when all of a sudden a shadow moves across the flame...
records.en: Imagine walking down a road at night by lantern light, when all of a sudden a shadow moves across the flame...

records.jp: それって、もしかして……
records.en_original: You mean like—
records.en: You mean like—

records.jp: そう、その影の正体は……
records.en_original: That's right. The shadow is none other than—
records.en: That's right. The shadow is none other than—

records.jp: 熊さん……とか？
records.en_original: A bear? ...Or something?
records.en: A bear? ...Or something?

records.jp: え、熊？　いやいや……。<CR>熊だったら、逆に火を怖がるでしょ
records.en_original: A bear? That's not what I... Aren't bears afraid of fire anyway?
records.en: A bear? That's not what I... Aren't bears afraid of fire anyway?

records.jp: それは迷信。むしろ火に興味を示して近づいてくるよ。<CR>熊さんを侮っちゃ、ダメ
records.en_original: That's a myth. If anything they get curious and will come near it. Never underestimate bears.
records.en: That's a myth. If anything they get curious and will come near it. Never underestimate bears.

records.jp: え、そうなんだ……じゃなくて！<CR>あー……まあ、いいや
records.en_original: Oh, that's interesting...but that wasn't the point! Bah, never mind.
records.en: Oh, that's interesting...but that wasn't the point! Bah, never mind.

records.jp: こころって、あんまりこういうの怖がらないよね。<CR>肝が据わってるっていうかさ
records.en_original: You're not really fazed by this stuff, are you? You've got nerves of steel.
records.en: You're not really fazed by this stuff, are you? You've got nerves of steel.

records.jp: ……そうかも。肝試しとかやっても、<CR>なんでみんなが怖がるのかよくわからなくて
records.en_original: I guess not. I never understood why people get so scared with haunted houses and ghost stories.
records.en: I guess not. I never understood why people get so scared with haunted houses and ghost stories.

records.jp: 頼りになるなあ。<CR>何かホラーなことが起きたらこころに助けてもらお
records.en_original: I definitely need you with me if we ever have a ghostly encounter.
records.en: I definitely need you with me if we ever have a ghostly encounter.

records.jp: わたしで力になれるかな？
records.en_original: You really think I'd be much help?
records.en: You really think I'd be much help?

records.jp: なるなる。こころなら幽霊とかに遭遇しても<CR>気にせずおしゃべりできそうだもん
records.en_original: Of course I do! I bet you'd even start chatting with the ghosts without a second thought.
records.en: Of course I do! I bet you'd even start chatting with the ghosts without a second thought.

records.jp: ええ……？　でも、幽霊って昔に亡くなった人が<CR>化けて出たものでしょ？
records.en_original: I don't know about that... I mean, ghosts are spirits of people who died a long time ago, right?
records.en: I don't know about that... I mean, ghosts are spirits of people who died a long time ago, right?

records.jp: ちゃんと話合うかな？<CR>ジェネレーションギャップとかすごそう……
records.en_original: I don't know if we'd have much to talk about...
records.en: I don't know if we'd have much to talk about...

records.jp: そういうとこだよ
records.en_original: See, this is exactly what I need.
records.en: See, this is exactly what I need.

records.jp: 一度でいいからこころを怖がらせてみたいなあ
records.en_original: I wish I could scare you just once.
records.en: I wish I could scare you just once.

records.jp: ええ……やめてよー
records.en_original: Hey... That doesn't sound fun.
records.en: Hey... That doesn't sound fun.

records.jp: こころが怖がることって何だろう……。<CR>幽霊や物の怪の類じゃダメそうだしなあ
records.en_original: I wonder what it is that you're afraid of... Ghosts and spooky ghouls are obviously not gonna work.
records.en: I wonder what it is that you're afraid of... Ghosts and spooky ghouls are obviously not gonna work.

records.jp: 怖いものかあ……。あっ
records.en_original: What am I scared of...? Oh.
records.en: What am I scared of...? Oh.

records.jp: 何かあるの？　教えて教えて！
records.en_original: There's something, isn't there?! Tell me!
records.en: There's something, isn't there?! Tell me!

records.jp: うーん、人に言うのは恥ずかしいんだけど……。<CR>愛央ちゃんにだけ特別だよ？
records.en_original: Well, I'm a little embarrassed to say...but I'll tell you because you're special.
records.en: Hmm... I'm embarrassed to tell anyone, but this is just for you, Ao-chan.

records.jp: わたしが怖いものは……
records.en_original: What scares me is...
records.en: What scares me is...

records.jp: うんうん！
records.en_original: Yes, yes? Go on!
records.en: Yes, yes? Go on!

records.jp: ……ごはん、かな。<CR>怖くて二度と見たくないなあ、おいしいごはん……
records.en_original: ...Food. I would totally freak out if there was a bunch of delicious food right in front of me, ready to eat.
records.en: ...Food. I would totally freak out if there was a bunch of delicious food right in front of me, ready to eat.

records.jp: そう来たかあー……<CR>じゃあ、後で思いっきり怖がらせちゃおっかな
records.en_original: Oh, so that's how you're gonna play this, huh? Guess I'll have to prepare so I can scare you a bunch later.
records.en: Oh, so that's how you're gonna play this, huh? Guess I'll have to prepare so I can scare you a bunch later.

records.jp: ふふ、やった
records.en_original: Hehe, I can't wait.
records.en: Hehe, I can't wait.

records.jp: それじゃあ、そろそろいこっか
records.en_original: Well, I think it's about time to get going.
records.en: Well, I think it's about time to get going.

records.jp: うん……あれ？
records.en_original: Okay. ...Huh?
records.en: Okay. ...Huh?

records.jp: ……？　どしたの？
records.en_original: Hm? What's wrong?
records.en: Hm? What's wrong?

records.jp: 今、灯籠の陰に何かいなかった？
records.en_original: I thought I saw something behind the lantern.
records.en: I thought I saw something behind the lantern.

records.jp: ええっ！？　まさか……
records.en_original: What?! Don't tell me...
records.en: What?! Don't tell me...

records.jp: こ、怖がらせようってってそうはいかないよ。<CR>こころったら冗談が上手いんだから
records.en_original: Y-you better not be trying to scare me! I won't fall for your pranks!
records.en: Y-you better not be trying to scare me! I won't fall for your pranks!

records.jp: え、冗談のつもりはなかったけど……
records.en_original: But I wasn't trying to prank you...
records.en: But I wasn't trying to prank you...

records.jp: ……んー、やっぱり気のせいかな？<CR>でも一瞬何か見えたような……
records.en_original: Hmm, it may have just but my imagination, but I swear I saw something move...
records.en: Hmm, it may have just but my imagination, but I swear I saw something move...

records.jp: こ、こころ～……
records.en_original: K-Kokoro...
records.en: K-Kokoro...

records.jp: まあ、大丈夫。<CR>何かあったらわたしが愛央ちゃんを守るよ
records.en_original: Well, don't worry about it. If anything happens, I'll protect you, Ao.
records.en: Well, don't worry about it. If anything happens, I'll protect you, Ao-chan.

records.jp: 何か「いる」んだ……
records.en_original: Some "thing" or some "one"?
records.en: Some "thing" or some "one"?

records.jp: 試しに話しかけてみよっか
records.en_original: Maybe I should try talking to it.
records.en: Maybe I should try talking to it.

records.jp: いやいやいや！<CR>触れちゃダメなやつだよきっと！　そっとしとこ！
records.en_original: No, don't! Stuff like this is better left alone!
records.en: No, don't! Stuff like this is better left alone!

records.jp: ……あれ？　やっぱり何もいない？
records.en_original: Huh. I guess there's nothing there.
records.en: Huh. I guess there's nothing there.

records.jp: き、気のせいだよきっと！　いこいこ！
records.en_original: S-see? It was just your imagination! I'm sure of it! Come on, let's go!
records.en: S-see? It was just your imagination! I'm sure of it! Come on, let's go!

records.jp: うーん、そうなのかな？
records.en_original: Hmm... Was it really?
records.en: Hmm... Was it really?

records.jp: フラグメント「<CLGR>%s<CLNR>」を<CR>手に入れました
records.en_original: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
